$comment: P16a post text templates. A target may carry kinds.montage / kinds.won-reel / kinds.long-highlights text overrides (D301, D406); a clip (kind short) uses the base text. youtube-video is the target for finished videos that are not Shorts (horizontal, or longer than the Shorts limit in limits.json). Placeholders only: {handles.x}, {links.x} come from the local profile (data/profile.local.json) at export time; {date} is the stream date (UTC, from candidates.json recordStartUtc); {n} is the clip's rank in the run. Never put names, brands or channel ids here. Chat text, viewer names, marker notes and candidate reasons are never used in post text.
$textPools: PT1 (D408, 2026-11-21): title and lead lines per kind, picked from the clip's facts (services/posting/post-text.mjs). Facts a line may name: {medal}, {killsText} (e.g. 3 KILLS), {kills} (the number), {result}, {mode}; they come from services/clip/reel_thumbnail.py facts() and are stored in post.json source.facts. A line naming a fact the clip does not have is never used (no guessing); a title over the platform's title limit is never used; the last recentLines lines used are not used again. Lines may also use {handles.x}/{links.x}; never {n} or {date} (an older draft redrafted does not know them). Per-game lines add to these from data/games/<id>/posting.json. No line here at all for a kind: the target's title and description above are used.
